decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer shares the firm's core inkjet technology, service and consumables, so holding it costs little, and the move toward serialization keeps its upside open even though recent website evidence is missing.

Coding non-absorbent surfaces is a broad, recurring need that draws on the firm's ink expertise and generates consumables revenue, so the option is cheap to keep and nothing so far shows its value won't be realized.
The CodeScan app succeeded PharmaScan and supports the firm's traceability and verification strategy at very low upkeep cost, so keeping it as a low-cost digital option makes sense.
Inline code verification sits directly on the firm's strategic path toward serialization and end-to-end traceability, so its value is likely rising and justifies continued commitment.
Layout design software ties into the common operation of the firm's printers and was featured on the home page, so it costs little to keep and strengthens the integrated solution offer.
